content.title: Masters 2026 payouts: Final prize money distribution, full player list
content.text: April 12, 2026Updated April 13, 2026, 10:03 a.m. ETRory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters, securing a $4.5 million prize from a record $22.5 million purse.The total prize money for the 2026 tournament was the largest in Masters history, increasing by $1.5 million from 2025.All professional golfers who participated received a cash prize, with those missing the cut earning $25,000.Amateur players are not eligible for prize money, and for the second consecutive year, no amateur made the cut.From the $4.5 million winner's share to payouts down the leaderboard, the 2026 Masters purse was the largest in tournament history. See how it was divided among players.Back-to-back Masters Champion Rory McIlroy secured his second green jacket after shooting 71 in the final round for a total of 12-under and the victory.The 2026 Masters purse totaled $22.5 million, the largest in tournament history and a $1.5 million increase from 2025.Winning the 2026 Masters came with a huge payday, but every player in the Masters field, except for amateurs, left Augusta with a check. Here’s the full prize money breakdown by finish.Masters players who miss cut get paidProfessional golfers who miss the cut at the Masters are paid $25,000 each.Do amateurs in the Masters get paid?Amateurs who play in the Masters Tournament do not receive monetary prizes.The amateur with the lowest score at the end of the Tournament wins a silver cup. However, for the second year in a row, no amateur made the cut at the Masters.How much prize money does the Masters 2026 winner Rory McIlroy get?2026 Masters winner Rory McIlroy will get a whopping $4.5 million check from the $22.5 million purse.Masters 2026 payout by position. Final prize money distribution for each playerThe 2026 Masters purse is $22.5 million, up from $21.5 million in 2025.Professional players who missed the cut each receive $25,000.
